product_metadata.title: Relaxing Candles for Home by BASK - Scented Candles - Summer Candles - Gifts for Women and Men - Scent: Wake Up
features: IMAGINATIVE FRAGRANCES: Each of our scented candles is crafted to bring a unique aromatic experience to any room. The Wake Up candle includes notes of Eucalyptus, Musk, Teakwood, Earth, for a pleasant ambiance.

PREMIUM SCENTED BLEND: Each unique blend is crafted from high-quality wax with a cotton wick that makes for durability and a consistent burn. Our long-burning candles have an impressive burn time of 80 hours and are both smokeless and dripless.

NON-TOXIC CLEAN BURNING: Made from 100% natural wax, these candles are scented with high-quality essential oils that infuse your home with a pleasing aroma. Our scented candles are always free from toxins and harmful residues.

DISTINGUISHED GIFT: Celebrate a housewarming, new job, birthdays, anniversaries, or any special occasion with our scented candles. Every candle comes in an elegant package that makes it a stunning gift for friends and loved ones.

BASK: Bask was created by a family with deep roots in candle-making. Equal parts aesthetically pleasing and durable, Bask candles are made with the utmost care from only the highest-quality ingredients.
